title.ru: Совет: should, ought to, need to
title.en: Advice: should, ought to, need to
title.es: Consejo: should, ought to, need to

pattern.en: We shouldn't stay up so late.
pattern.ru: Нам не стоит так поздно ложиться.

pattern.en: You need to update the app.

text.ru: should — совет, «стоит / следует»: You should rest. Вопрос-совет: Should I…? — «Мне стоит…?» ought to — то же, чуть официальнее. need to — «нужно» (необходимость), don't need to — «не нужно» (как don't have to). После should — глагол без to.
text.en: should = advice: You should rest. Should I…? asks for advice. ought to = the same, more formal. need to = necessity; don't need to = not necessary. No to after should.

rule.formula: should / shouldn't + V · need to + V · don't need to + V

head: пример
смысл
rows: I need to charge my phone.
You don't need to bring anything.

exercises.en: You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
exercises.ru: Ты выглядишь уставшим. Тебе стоит лечь спать.

exercises.en: You ___ pay now — you can pay later.
exercises.ru: Платить сейчас не нужно — можно потом.

exercises.en: ___ I bring anything to the party?
You shouldn't drink coffee in the evening.

prompt.ru: Дайте совет другу, который хочет выучить английский.
prompt.en: Give advice to a friend who wants to learn English.
prompt.es: Da un consejo a un amigo que quiere aprender inglés.

exercises.sample: You should watch films in English. You shouldn't be afraid of mistakes.
